Brief: Tell me about the Silk Road and elaborate on its influence. — about Roman Empire (30 BCE – 3rd century CE)

Kept:

2. With control of these trade routes, citizens of the Roman Empire received new luxuries and greater prosperity for the Empire as a whole.
3. The Greco-Roman trade with India started by Eudoxus of Cyzicus in 130 BCE continued to increase, and according to Strabo (II.5.12), by the time of Augustus, up to 120 ships were setting sail every year from Myos Hormos in Roman Egypt to India.
